what: States of a moving chain that are neither the wide kink I nor the completed step B, and bands between them and the named states (examples/kink_wide_cell.py settle, between); kcal/mol against the sheet of the row, cell fixed. M: one sharp gauche bond (bond 4), its partner spread over bonds 2 and 3. N: a kink pair of the other hand two monomers on (G- at bond 4, G+ at bond 6). Q (64/29/7) and P (71/29): the same gauche bonds as N, higher, on the way to it from the sheet. P of 64/29/7 is the sheet itself (an image of the band from I to N relaxed to it). A in a band's name is the sheet (kinked_crystal.state).
evaluated: on an NVIDIA A100 in the batched form (CuPy), 2026-11-14: queue_20261114.txt jobs 9 to 24 (bands in per-variable units: band_variables), queue_20261114_n.txt and _n2.txt (bands in the per-chain metric); the four-chain terpolymer M on a host
